question: By the 42ⁿd Amendment in 1976 , as introduced by the _____, the Chapter on the fundamental duties of citizens was incorporated into the Constitution.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swaran Singh Committee.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idea of Fundamental Duties is inspired by the** Constitution of Russia.**
 
• These were incorporated in **Part IV-A **of the Constitution by the **42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976** on the recommendations of the **Swaran Singh Committee.**</li
